requirements.normative_requirement: Admission observes host CPU, memory, and I/O PSI in addition to static resource limits.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Static limits miss real host contention
requirements.primary_verification: CPU/memory/I/O PSI injection with admission observations.

requirements.normative_requirement: Batch admission may be refused or paused when configured PSI or inference-latency thresholds are exceeded.
Unknown D1 effects are never preempted or replayed as if they were restartable D0 reads.
requirements.primary_verification: Cancellation/preemption tests proving D1 unknown is quarantined, not replayed.
